nodes.label: Murshid Safety Platform (مرشد السلامة)
nodes.rationale: Single-file Arabic RTL HSE training platform combining Kawader exam simulation, AI field tools, gamification, and the founder's personal brand; single-file design chosen for trivially easy static hosting.

nodes.label: openai-proxy Supabase Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Server-side AI proxy holding the founder's OpenAI key with per-user daily limits (429 handling), so end users never see or supply an API key.

nodes.label: FCONFIG (founder configuration)
nodes.rationale: Cloud-persisted founder config (landing copy, tool visibility, branding, legal text, custom questions, AI limit) lets the founder control content without touching code.

nodes.label: buildSys (Abu Salama system prompt builder)
nodes.rationale: Injects user profile, XP, streak, and top weaknesses into the AI system prompt so chat responses are personalized to the learner's Saudi HSE context.

nodes.label: startWarmup (morning warmup quiz)
nodes.rationale: Tries AI-generated questions first, falls back to the local bank via getBankQ on failure — quiz works fully without AI access.

nodes.label: hseAnalyze (AI photo violation analyzer)
nodes.rationale: Vision analysis (gpt-4o) of site photos producing a structured report: root cause, 5-Why, Bow-Tie, 5x5 risk score, hierarchy of controls, standards citations (ISO 45001, OSHA, GSO, ILO).

nodes.label: Positioning critique
nodes.rationale: Field-credibility positioning is good, but the platform must pick one primary audience (most likely Kawader exam candidates) and aim its entire message at them before expanding.

nodes.label: Missing sharp value proposition
nodes.rationale: Generic 'integrated training' messaging should be replaced with a measurable promise such as 'pass the Kawader exam on your first attempt' or 'save 5 hours a week on inspection reports'.

nodes.label: OpenAI API key barrier
nodes.rationale: Requiring every user to create an OpenAI account and paste a key loses 90%+ of non-technical users — acceptable for a personal tool, fatal for a mass-market platform.

nodes.label: Backend AI proxy recommendation (Supabase/Cloudflare Edge Function)
nodes.rationale: Ideal fix for the key barrier: an Edge Function holding the founder's key with per-user usage limits, so users never see any key; interim fix is a capped free tier plus fully AI-free features (Kawader, flashcards, matrix) as a conversion bait.
nodes.norm_label: backend ai proxy recommendation (supabase/cloudflare edge function)

nodes.label: Fabricated testimonials / missing social proof
nodes.rationale: Testimonials look invented (names without links or photos); if discovered this damages credibility — replace with real ones or remove.

nodes.label: Personal branding strategy
nodes.rationale: Founder presence on every page plus direct LinkedIn link builds the personal brand, but needs a real photo, an expanded bio with certifications (NEBOSH/OSHA), and quantified achievements to earn trust.

nodes.label: Missing analytics (no visitor measurement)
nodes.rationale: No Google Analytics/Plausible means no knowledge of visitor counts, sources, or drop-off — called the single most important marketing gap ('flying without a compass').

nodes.label: Supabase auth and cross-device sync plan
nodes.rationale: localStorage-only storage is being resolved by connecting Supabase for authentication and cross-device synchronization (listed as in-progress).
nodes.norm_label: supabase auth and cross-device sync plan

nodes.label: Revenue model options (Freemium / subscription / B2B / lead generation)
nodes.rationale: Recommended sequence: start with lead generation (platform as marketing front-end bringing consulting/training opportunities via LinkedIn), then add Freemium once the audience grows; B2B corporate training rated highest value.
nodes.norm_label: revenue model options (freemium / subscription / b2b / lead generation)

nodes.label: Competitive advantage analysis
nodes.rationale: Question banks are easily copied by competitors (apps, Telegram/YouTube channels, courses); the durable moat is the personal brand plus user experience, so investment should go there.
